messages:
acme_payments: Hey team — our prod account was suspended this morning, billing says invoice INV-2026-0421 is "Pending" and payment failed. We tried the card on file and it declined, but also our PO (PO-8892) wasn’t attached to the invoice. We requested Net 45 for Q2 instead of upfront billing — did that trigger something? Services impacted (small spike): data-ingest and embeddings ingestion. Can someone unblock?

mikaela_support: Sorry about that — I can look. Quick checks: can you confirm the last4 on the card that was charged? Also upload the PO and VAT ID to the support form or paste them here. If you want Net 45 we need an approved amendment from Finance before reissuing invoices.

acme_payments: Card shows last4 `4242` in our portal. PO file attached in the ticket (PO-8892.pdf). VAT ID is `GB999888777`. We submitted the net terms request last week but haven't seen confirmation. We’re in the middle of a rollout so this is pretty urgent.

mikaela_support: Got the PO and VAT ID, ty. I'm going to request a provisional unblock while Finance reviews. @raj_finance can you advise on provisional credit and whether we can reissue INV-2026-0421 with PO attached and Net 45 pending amendment?

raj_finance: Billing note: card gateway returned a `card_declined` for transaction `txn_2032abc`. We can provide a one-time provisional credit to avoid disruption, up to $5,000, for 7 days while paperwork completes. To finalize Net 45 we need: signed payment-terms amendment (e-sign), updated billing contact, and the PO on file listing the billing address and VAT ID. I’ll also need the signed SOW if this is an enterprise commit.

billing-bot: Payment gateway response (auto): ```{
  "transaction":"txn_2032abc",
  "status":"failed",
  "code":"card_declined",
  "decline_reason":"insufficient_funds"
}```

derek_am: Adding context from my side — Acme has been approved for Net terms historically but this account switched to prepay during onboarding. I have the approval thread with Legal and their PO team. I’ll ping their procurement to sign the amendment today. If finance issues provisional credit, please note we need logs of the amount cleared and the date of reissue.

mikaela_support: Action plan: 1) I’ll request provisional credit now. 2) Reissue invoice with PO attached and VAT ID if Finance OKs. 3) Temporarily lift service block if credit approved. 4) Wait for signed amendment to make Net 45 permanent.

acme_payments: Appreciate it. Can you reissue the invoice with a line that shows `PO: PO-8892` and updated VAT? Also please confirm when services are back online — ingest has failed jobs we need retried.

raj_finance: Confirmed: provisional credit of $4,800 approved and applied to account (internal ref BF-2112). That should clear the outstanding balance for INV-2026-0421. We will reissue a corrected invoice (INV-2026-0421-R1) with the PO and VAT. Permanent Net 45 will require the signed amendment — I sent the e-sign link to the billing contact on record.

mikaela_support: Reissued invoice as `INV-2026-0421-R1` and attached PO/ VAT. Lifting service block now. Please monitor and let us know if anything else pops. :thumbsup:

acme_payments: Received, services are back. We see some queued jobs processing now. Thanks. One Q: if the signed amendment is delayed beyond 7 days, does the provisional credit get reversed automatically?

raj_finance: Good question. If amendment not signed within 7 days we’ll reverse provisional credit and re-block services; we’ll give a 24-hour heads-up. We prefer to avoid that — please sign the amendment or reply to the e-sign with the expected date.

acme_payments: Understood. Procurement is reviewing today, should be signed by EOD tomorrow. I’ll follow up here once done.

mikaela_support: Great — leaving this thread open until amendment signed. Reassigning to `support` queue + `billing` for any follow-up. :eyes:
